items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: That was the first time I'd ever seen Fetchit. Then this Chicago incident was the second time. So I began to form my conclusions about him, you know.

ctx.x: He was in this revue, and he was doing that same act that he became famous later on by -- right in Swingland. Open the Door, Richard." And I remember distinctly one night we had a visitor sitting right at the door. The place was packed on Saturday night, and the MC, whose name was Rubel Blakely -- that just came to me. He was quite a guy, and he happened to recognize this particular guy in the audience, sitting near the door. You know who this guy was? Steppin' Fetchit.
